newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to net 25 bln reais with selloffs in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to net 25 bln reais with selloffs in 97/98.

text.p: Brazil is expected to raise 25 billion reais in privatization receipts in 1997 and 1998, said Planning Minister Antonio Kandir.
Kandir said at least 10 billion reais will be raised this year. Of that total, some 4.0 billion reais should be in foreign investment, he said.

His estimates considers the sale of Band B cellular concessions, the complete privatization of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) and a public offering of shares in Light that remained in government's hands.
CVRD's privatization began earlier this month with the sale of a 41.73 percent voting stake to a group led by private steelmaker CSN.
Speaking at a forum on the Real Plan, Kandir said a global offering of CVRD shares is likely to take place in November and should amount to 2.0 billion reais.
The public offering of Light's shares, worth 1.3 billion reais, is expected to take place in October, he added.
Kandir also said the Band B selloffs are likely to net the government between 1.2 billion and 2.8 billion reais in 1997.
He expects 6.0 billion reais in foreign investment in Brazil's privatizations next year.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom 5521 5074151))
